title: Phone related-list card draws a currency formula column as a bare unlabeled number (12,000 beside 销售单价 6,000.00; desktop shows 总计 12,000.00)
body:
## What happens

On a phone, a record page's related list draws its rows as gallery cards (`RelatedList.tsx` hands `object-gallery` the first column as title and columns 2 to 4 as `visibleFields`). A column that is a **formula returning currency** is drawn on the card as a bare number: no field label, and not in the money format the same column has on desktop.

Measured on `@objectstack/*` 18.6.0 with HotCRM 6.6.0, 375×812 viewport, zh-CN:

| Surface | Quantity | Unit price (`currency`) | Total (`formula`, `returnType: 'currency'`) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Desktop related-list table | `2` | `6,000.00` | `12,000.00` under the header 总计 |
| Phone card | `数量 2` | `销售单价 6,000.00` | `12,000` with no label |

So a card reads "数量 2 / 销售单价 6,000.00 / 12,000", and the reader cannot tell what 12,000 is. This is the case the comment on `LOW_SEMANTIC_RENDERER_TYPES` in `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ObjectGallery.tsx` says the label exists to prevent ("the user has no way to tell whether `5,000,000` is revenue, headcount, or pipeline value").

## Why (read on `main`)

`ObjectGallery.tsx` prefixes the label only when the resolved renderer type is one of `number`, `currency`, `percent`, `integer`, `decimal`. A formula (and, by the same reading, a summary) whose result is a number or an amount resolves to a renderer type outside that set, so `showLabel` is false. The value is also drawn without the two decimals the table gives the same field, and `buildEnrichedField` in the same file copies `type`, `label`, `options`, `currency`, `precision`, `scale`, `useGrouping` from the field definition but not `returnType`, so the cell renderer cannot know the formula is an amount.

## Steps

1. HotCRM, Sales app, open an opportunity that has product lines (object `crm_opportunity_line_item`; `total_price` is `Field.formula({ returnType: 'currency' })`).
2. Narrow the viewport to a phone width and look at the 商机产品明细 related list.

## Expected

A formula or summary column whose result is a number, an amount or a percentage gets the same label prefix as a stored number on the card, and the same format as the desktop table cell (`总计 12,000.00`).

## Actual

`12,000`, unlabeled, beside `销售单价 6,000.00`.
